Subject: SIG/CAIQ kickoff — request to schedule & evidence window

Hi Camila / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. HelioMed is kicking off a SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 evidence intake as part of our procurement + third-party risk review. We want to set a 60-min kickoff to: 1) align scope (SIG vs CAIQ), 2) confirm evidence windows, and 3) identify artifact owners and any redaction constraints.

High-level asks from our side:
- CAIQ/SIG answers (if you already have a CAIQ completed, great)
- Access/authentication logs (sample 30–90 days) and a short description of log retention
- Network diagram and VPC/peering summary
- Key management/encryption policy and rotation cadence
- SOC 2 report if available (or attestation date)

Can you do a kickoff next week? We are flexible but would prefer Jan 14–15. I attached a short spreadsheet with our prelim questions (HelioMed_SIG_Prelim_Questions.xlsx). Also looping in our legal contact (marta.liu@heliomed.com) and our auditor (audit@auditpartners.com) once we lock timing.

Let me know two slots you can do and who on your side will own logs and encryption questions.

Thanks,
Sam Roberts

Hi all — thanks for the kickoff today. Quick summary and action items (so we have a single source of truth):

Scope confirmed:
- Primary: CAIQ mapping + SIG evidence handoff; SOC2 attestation discussion (no new audit scheduled).

Action items (owners & timelines):
- Sam (HelioMed): drop the CAIQ draft and prelim answers into the shared Drive by EOD Tue 1/19.
- Marissa (Redwood): review HelioMed draft and return comments (small clarifications) by Fri 1/22.
- Irene (Redwood): produce log sampling instructions and a 2-file sample (auth logs + request traces), target delivery to HelioMed by Tue 1/26. See attached: redwood-log-sample-instructions.pdf
- Ben (Redwood): confirm KMS/key rotation policy and send the policy excerpt + link to the public KMS FAQ by Wed 1/20.
- Legal coordination: Marta Liu (HelioMed) to confirm any redaction/NDA requirements — if needed, we will route artifacts through our secure transfer process.

Notes / clarifications from the call:
- Log retention: production auth logs retained for 180 days; long-term aggregated metrics retained for 24 months.
- Data residency: primary storage in us-west-2; no EU-only buckets for HelioMed tenancy unless expressly requested — we can discuss export or EU region options if required.
- Transfer options: SFTP (recommended for third-party auditors), secure Drive link (short-lived), or signed S3 URL via our secure transfer broker.

Related links:
- Shared doc (read/write for HelioMed): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbcExampleDriveLink
- HubSpot record: HubSpot: 67890-HEL-MED

I'll follow up after I upload the log instructions and the 2-file sample. If anyone wants the extraction runbook in a different format (CSV vs ndjson) let me know — default will be compressed ndjson.
